subject.title: feat(hooks): add waitForResult mode to POST /hooks/agent endpoint

question: Should this PR's `waitForResult`/`announceToMain` contract be accepted as the permanent public `/hooks/agent` result-return API, including raw result/error response semantics and idempotency behavior?
rationale: The code path is coherent, but it changes a gateway security/session-state boundary by reflecting agent output and errors over authenticated HTTP while holding requests open; automation cannot choose that product/security contract.

options.title: Accept With Hardening
options.body: Adopt the existing endpoint extension after aligning the mapped replay response and requiring current-head real HTTP proof for direct wait, async, error, and replay behavior.

options.title: Reshape The Contract
options.body: Ask the contributor to keep the implementation but move to a dedicated sync endpoint, result URL, redacted errors, size caps, or another maintainer-selected API shape.

options.title: Decline Core Sync Hooks
options.body: Close or park this PR if maintainers prefer the existing async hook plus sessions_history workflow or a plugin-owned integration instead.

recommendation.title: Accept With Hardening
recommendation.body: Adopt the existing endpoint extension after aligning the mapped replay response and requiring current-head real HTTP proof for direct wait, async, error, and replay behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest recent source-history signal on the central hook request/dispatch files and the replay/session-key behavior this PR changes.
